'''2009 Dantooine Regionals Chris Fanchi DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Fanchi]] at [[2009 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Take A Dump
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
